_comment: The expected image identity for scripts/g4_pipeline, declared outside the build output.
build.sh reads this file and fails (exit 75) when the image it built hashes to anything else.
It must never be read back from results/image_identity.txt, which build.sh writes: comparing a
value against the file the same run just produced is true by construction and detects nothing.
expected_image_id is the digest L7 recorded as the canonical target
(docs/validation/2026-09-29-g4-t5-unit-citation-legacy-removal.md). It is deliberately NOT
re-baselined to the 0f278c22 a drifted rebuild produced. Issue 324 forbids silently replacing
the expected digest; changing it is an operator decision, not a build artifact.
What IS pinned mechanically and does reproduce: the base image digest, the apt snapshot and its
188 recorded package versions, and all 104 Python requirements with their sha256 hashes.
builder declares the build path the pin is measured on. As of issue 324 C1 operator option (a)
(docs/validation/2026-09-30-g4-buildkit-reproducibility.md) the build path is `docker buildx` on
a BuildKit container builder under the declared memory ceiling, exporting with
rewrite-timestamp=true at the declared SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. build.sh compares engine, plugin,
builder existence, driver, BuildKit version and ceiling against this declaration BEFORE building;
a host that cannot run the declared path exits 65. Probe measurements (2026-09-30, this branch)
show this path reproduces byte-identical image ids for clean builds of the declared step shapes;
the full pinned image has NOT yet been proved reproducible post --no-compile fix (63601e6), so
no new baseline is declared here and expected_image_id remains the unmatched L7 value.
cpuset_cpus is null because the buildx path bounds only memory (via --driver-opt): the legacy
`docker build --cpuset-cpus=0-3` CPU affinity is dropped there, and recording that as data rather
than prose keeps the omission explicit and reversible only by editing this field.

builder.source: operator option (a), docs/validation/2026-09-30-g4-buildkit-reproducibility.md; engine per docs/validation/2026-09-29-324-c1-reproducible-pin.md Environment table
builder.note: The legacy builder named by the earlier declaration cannot reproduce a fixed digest and was retired by the operator's option (a) decision; this block pins the replacement path mechanically. It is NOT a claim that the full pinned image reproduces: that needs two clean buildx builds of this Dockerfile since the --no-compile fix, not yet run.

blocking_reason: expected_image_id is the L7 value built with the now-retired legacy builder and is unreachable by any builder; it is kept declared and unmatched per the issue. Closing C1 needs the operator to accept a new baseline proven by two independent clean builds of the full pinned Dockerfile on this buildx path (remaining evidence: the 2026-09-30 record measured two such builds BEFORE the --no-compile fix differing in 2 of 11 layers; the fix is untested at full scale here).
